title: Invertibility of the canonical derived pullback comparison for an intrinsically flat module
statement: Choose shared derived-category localizations [def-pc-derived-category]. Let a:X → Y be any scheme morphism [def-pc-scheme]. Assume tensorPullback a [def-pc-module-pullback] is additive. Let G be a quasi-coherent O_Y-module [pqf-def-coherent] with IsFlatOver G (identity Y) [def-pc-scheme-module-flat-over]. Every morphism c:La*(G[0]) → (a*G)[0] satisfying IsDerivedModulePullbackComparison [def-pc-derived-module-base-change-map] is invertible. No base-change square or direct image occurs.

source.place: Tags 06YD and 06YJ: bounded-above flat complexes are K-flat and compute derived pullback; single-complex specialization

proof.text: Unpack the comparison predicate. Intrinsic flatness gives tensor flatness; apply the flat-single counit theorem. The localized single-complex pullback map is an isomorphism by functoriality. Compose these isomorphisms and transport along the equality defining c.

theorem isIso_modulePullbackComparison_of_isFlatOver_identity
    [∀ Y : Scheme.{u},
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (a : X ⟶ Y) [(Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback a).Additive]
    (G : Y.Modules) [SheafOfModules.IsQuasicoherent.{u} G]
    (hflat : Scheme.Modules.IsFlatOver G (𝟙 Y))
    (c : (derivedPullback a).obj ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
          (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) 0).obj G) ⟶
        (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
          (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) 0).obj
            ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback a).obj G))
    (hc : IsDerivedModulePullbackComparison a G c) : IsIso c
